about: Every model configuration backtested for a strategy, so the Deflated Sharpe Ratio knows how many were tried. Add each new configuration here, with its run, in the same reviewed change that adds it. Never delete a trial. See docs/research-protocol.md.

C.holdoutNote: Everything before this date has already been seen while designing quant-c-v1 and v2, so the holdout is the period after the protocol was written. Its result is looked at once per model and recorded in holdoutRuns.

trials.note: Momentum 12-1 plus low volatility, equal weights. Sharpe as reported by the run, rounded to two places.
